description:
A refined fork of EarTrumpet with enhanced volume control and music overlay

BetterTrumpet is a refined fork of EarTrumpet, the beloved Windows volume mixer. Features include enhanced volume control, a slick music overlay, fully customizable colors, and a cleaner interface.
Version 3.3.0 brings a what's-new feed with live polls and surveys, a React/Fluent settings redesign with Sage Glass design language, anonymous telemetry, redesigned toast notifications, device-switch notifications, per-device hotkeys, and performance improvements.
